description: List bottles on another user's public shelf. Requires username or userId. Same status/query/paging as list_my_bottles. 404 if the user is missing; empty list if they have no bottles.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response (numeric offset)

query.description: Filter by display name, distillery, or notes

status.description: Bottle status or shelf group (active / wishlist / tried)

userId.description: Firebase uid of the target user

username.description: Instadram handle (with or without @). Resolved via usernames/{handle}.

name: list_user_bottles
